description:
Min-Chan has lived his whole life as part of the elite top 1%—an Alpha who always wins. Bored with his perfect life, he accepts a friend's invitation to join Fight Club, a brutal underground arena where only fighting skills matter. What starts as a casual thrill quickly escalates when Min-Chan begins competing himself—and winning easily, just like always. But just as victory starts to feel hollow, he faces an opponent he can't beat: Tae-Wook, a smaller, seemingly fragile Omega. Crushed by his first-ever defeat, Min-Chan is furious—and obsessed. He approaches Tae-Wook, only to be met with complete indifference, a blow to his pride he can't ignore. Then one night, fate strikes: Tae-Wook enters his heat cycle, and Min-Chan doesn’t miss his chance. Pride, instinct, and raw attraction collide—

In this fight, winning might mean losing everything Min-Chan thought he knew.

(Source: Lezhin US)
